_comment: Plugin-level hooks. Scripts live under hooks/. Remove '_comment' fields when adapting in production — JSON doesn't support comments.

PreToolUse._comment: Defense-in-depth for the Phase 1 GCS artifact fetch — base-tools' own EC2/GCP hook only covers `gcloud compute`, not `gcloud storage`, so this plugin needs its own backstop against the always-destructive gcloud storage verbs.
